identity: namespace + label + environment/service for components; namespace + label + source/event-id for events

construction_rules.catalog: An explicit depends_on declaration creates a declared dependency, valid until the next complete snapshot from that source/environment.
construction_rules.otlp: A cross-service CLIENT-to-SERVER or PRODUCER-to-CONSUMER parent-child pair in the same export is an observed dependency, expiring 15 minutes after observation.
construction_rules.logs: WARN, ERROR and FATAL records with an explicit error_type create symptoms. Logs do not establish dependencies or causes.
construction_rules.deployment: A deployment record establishes that a release changed a named component, not that it caused an incident.
construction_rules.finding: Confirmed causal knowledge requires explicit human confirmation. Ingestion cannot import confirmed findings.

control_plane.IngestionSource: Atomic byte offset, input fingerprint, source configuration hash, and last catalog timestamp; never sent to the investigator.
